changes.finding: A directly comparable NUTS2 adult-learning participation value is now frozen for Sud-Muntenia: 6.1% for 2022 in OECD Economic Survey Romania 2024 based on Eurostat EU-LFS. A recent institutional mirror of Eurostat trng_lfse_04 reports 11.4% for 2025, used only as corroborative trend evidence.
changes.guardrail: Do not combine the four-week EU-LFS indicator with 12-month adult-learning measures or interpret participation rate alone as an AI-specific skills deficit.

changes.finding: Current official ANOFM county data produce a conservative lower bound of 72,824 registered unemployed aged 30-55 across the three regions: 26,388 Sud-Vest Oltenia, 25,470 Sud-Muntenia and 20,966 Centru. Planned 160 equals about 0.22% of this administrative pool. Macro recruitment capacity is therefore strongly evidenced even before considering eligible employed persons.
changes.remaining_blocker: The evidence does not show that 160 people have the measured AI/digital skills deficit or willingness to participate, does not apply every GSCS exclusion, and does not justify 80/40/40 as relative need-weight. Primary/direct interest evidence remains required if the final narrative claims exact scale as need magnitude or empirically optimal allocation.
changes.release_effect: The final analysis may state that the planned scale is administratively plausible/feasible relative to the registered-unemployed pool; it may not state that 160 or 80/40/40 is the measured size/distribution of need.

changes.finding: OIR PECU Nord-Vest exposes a direct official MIPE URL for the 13-August consolidated 7Z package and confirms approval by MIPE Order 767/2026. A 24-August report citing MIPE indicates a further corrigendum and updated Annex 4, so final QA must capture the post-24-August official binaries.
changes.remaining_blocker: Exact current official guide/annex files and cryptographic hashes have not been captured. The direct official 13-August package timed out in the research environment and may no longer be the newest package after the 24-August corrigendum.

changes.finding: The existence and macro size of an age-compatible registered-unemployed pool are now strongly evidenced for all three regions. What remains unmeasured is the actual AI/digital competency profile, barriers, and training interest of eligible adults.
changes.resolution: Collect real first-party survey responses through the GDPR-safe eucons.ro instrument or obtain an equivalent direct dataset with region/status/age-band metadata.

changes.finding: Secondary evidence can demonstrate technology-transition context and labour-market pressure but still does not directly identify which AI/digital capabilities employers in the three regions observe as insufficient in relevant workflows.
changes.resolution: Collect employer/organisation responses or structured interview evidence; keep contact details separate from the analytic dataset.

changes.finding: National digital-intensity and regional innovation evidence strengthen context but are not a direct current measure of firm AI/digital maturity in Sud-Vest Oltenia.
changes.guardrail: Do not promote innovation index, R&D intensity or national digital intensity into a regional employer skill-gap measure.

changes.finding: Regional labour-market/education indicators and national digital-intensity evidence strengthen context but are not a direct current measure of firm AI/digital maturity in Sud-Muntenia.
changes.guardrail: Do not promote strategic priority or low high-tech employment automatically into an employer AI skills deficit.
